{{short description|Indian businessman}} {{BLP sources|date=April 2012}} {{Use Indian English|date=May 2014}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2026}} {{Infobox person | name = Harsh Chitale | image = Harsh_Chitale.jpg|alt=Harsh Chitale | caption = Harsh Chitale | occupation = Ex-CEO & previous Whole Time Director of HCL Infosystems {{cite web |url=https://businesstoday.intoday.in/story/young-indian-business-leaders-harsh-chitale/1/15127.html |title=Harsh Chitale, Ex-CEO, HCL Infosystems |publisher=[[Business Today (business magazine)|Business Today]] |author=Business Today |date= 15 May 2011 }} | alma_mater = [[IIT Delhi]] | parents = Madhav Atmaram Chitale and Vijaya Chitale | spouse = Mrunalini Chitale | children = | website = | footnotes = }} '''Harsh Chitale''' was the previous CEO of HCL Infosystems. ==Early life and education== Harsh did his initial schooling at Chikitsak Samuha Shirolkar High School, a Marathi-medium school in Mumbai. Later, he moved to [[Delhi Public School, R. K. Puram]] where he completed high-school. Harsh obtained his degree in Electrical Engineering, from [[IIT Delhi]], graduating in 1993. He also received the Director's gold medal at IIT Delhi. {{cite web |url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=21905644&ticker=4509811 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130118194902/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=21905644&ticker=4509811 |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 January 2013 |title=Harsh Chitale, Ex-CEO, HCL Infosystems |publisher=[[BusinessWeek]] |author=Business Week }} ==Career== Before HCL, Harsh was the Vice President & GM (Americas Business) of Honeywell Process Solutions (a division of [[Honeywell]] International Inc.). Prior to that, he was the Vice President (Global Marketing) of Honeywell Process Solutions, since 1 November 2006.

Harsh started his career, working with the [[Tata group]], in Tata Administration Services (TAS). From December 2004, to November 2006, Harsh worked as Managing Director Honeywell Automation India Ltd.(then, Tata Honeywell Ltd.). He also served as the CEO. Harsh served as Non-executive Vice Chairman and Director, Honeywell Automation India Ltd., till October 2008. {{cite web |url = http://www.informationweek.in/Software/10-10-04/Harsh_Chitale_appointed_CEO_of_HCL_Infosystems.aspx |title = Ex-CEO of HCL Infosystems |publisher = [[InformationWeek]] |author = InformationWeek |date = 4 October 2010 |url-status = dead |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20101125042459/http://www.informationweek.in/Software/10-10-04/Harsh_Chitale_appointed_CEO_of_HCL_Infosystems.aspx |archive-date = 25 November 2010 |df = dmy-all }} ==References== {{Reflist|30em}} ==External links== * [https://archive.today/20130118194902/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=21905644&ticker=4509811 Harsh Chitale, Executive Profile and Biography] at [[Business Week]] {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Chitale, Harsh}} [[Category:Businesspeople from Delhi]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Year of birth missing (living people)]]
